Documents needed

Documents needed for your car loan application

Documents can vary across finance partners for banking and non-banking customers, but these are the core categories commonly requested.

General documents

  • Valid Passport copy
  • UAE Residence Visa
  • Emirates ID (front and back)
  • Signed bank consent forms

If you're salaried

  • 3 months bank statement
  • 3 months payslip
  • Salary certificate

If you're self-employed

  • Trade License
  • MoA / authorised signatory paperwork
  • VAT Certificate
  • 6 month bank statement

Additional documents

  • Ownership document
  • Bank valuation certificate

Loan FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Answers to the most common used-car loan questions in the UAE.

Who is eligible for zero downpayment?

Customers who qualify for financing may also qualify for zero downpayment depending on bank rules, income profile, and DBR assessment.

Can I get a loan if I already have a running loan?

Yes, subject to lender review and your updated EMI eligibility after considering existing obligations.

What is the minimum salary requirement for a loan?

The minimum requirement varies by lender and can depend on whether you are salaried or self-employed and whether you are already banking with the lender.

Can someone else apply for a loan on my behalf?

In some cases, an immediate family member may apply if they meet the lender's eligibility requirements.
